title: KoolKisaan ledger block (one per event, per slip)
description: hash = SHA-256 of index|ts|slipId|type|actor|canonical(payload)|canonical(physics)|prevHash. canonical = JSON with sorted keys, no spaces, numbers rounded to 4 decimals and whole numbers written as integers. Code: engine/trust_ledger.py and web/trust/trust_core.js.

payload.description: Depends on type. CHECKIN: slipId, farmer, crop, kg, basePrice_INR_kg, bay, harvest_h, T_field_C, RH_field_pct, lastAnchor. READING: see telemetry.schema.json (step, N1..N4, out, P_el_W). HANDOVER_OUT: transporterId, vehicle, produce_T_C. TRANSIT: T_box_C, T_out_C, source. HANDOVER_IN: buyerId, produce_T_C. SALE: freshness_pct, price_INR_kg, total_INR, loss_INR.

phi.description: physics consistency index at this reading

from.description: ISO UTC time the run of high Φ started

raised.description: ISO UTC time Φ had been ≥ red_at for red_steps readings
